answer: Work history gets a time lock, so credit counts only while fresh work renews it each epoch. We are five people, so we read the ledger instead of out-hiring anyone. Old receipts are quartz, hard and inert and worthless the moment the pulse stops. Audits come from a rotating pool we do not pick, and every lapse drops an account a grade. A farm can age 200 accounts in parallel, then has to keep all 200 delivering or watch the copper run to zero.
